primitives.name: Prisma Schema Introspection Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`prisma db pull` (introspection) is the safe read-only direction.** Pointed at a real database, it reads the live schema and writes it into a *target* `.prisma` file — it never writes to the database.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'db_pull': 'schema reading operation (unitless)', 'schema.prisma': 'target schema file (dimensionless)', 'DATABASE_URL': 'live database connection string (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Introspection is a passive operation; no side effects on source database.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If used against a protected or production DB without isolation.

layer2.mapping: Derives a kernel of trust from read-only access, enabling schema validation without altering state.
layer2.telemetry: Success of schema export to .prisma file without error logs.

primitives.name: Schema Evolution Contract
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Migrate reads/writes** in application code to the new shape, both shapes supported simultaneously.
primitives.assumptions: Both schema versions coexist during transition period; application handles backward compatibility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Upon premature removal of legacy schema elements before full migration completion.

layer2.mapping: Represents a dual-isomorphic mapping between old and new schema states, ensuring semantic equivalence across transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Application behavior consistency check across schema versions.
